           CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.memb_days, 0) > 0

                ELSE 0

    FROM fans f
    LEFT JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.user_registry = m.member_fan_pivot
),

    SELECT i.interact_fan_pivot as fan_id,

    SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_fan_pivot) member_fan_pivot, spend_usd, memb_days
    FROM membershipandspending
    ORDER BY member_fan_pivot, member_reg DESC
),
fan_support AS (
    SELECT f.user_registry,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Supp_Tix', '0')::int +
               COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Bug_Subs', '0')::int +
               COALESCE(s.feedback_data->>'Tech_Issue_Rpt', '0')::int) as sls
    FROM fans f
    LEFT JOIN interactions i ON f.user_registry = i.interact_fan_pivot
    LEFT JOIN supportandfeedback s ON s.support_interact_pivot = i.activity_reg
    GROUP BY f.user_registry
),
fan_scores AS (
    SELECT f.user_registry,
           CASE WHEN fm.memb_days > 0 THEN fm.spend_usd / (fm.memb_days / 30.44) ELSE 0 END as ffv,
           COALESCE(fs.sls, 0) as sls
    FROM fans f
    LEFT JOIN fan_membership fm ON f.user_registry = fm.member_fan_pivot
    LEFT JOIN fan_support fs ON f.user_registry = fs.user_registry
),
fan_quadrants AS (
    SELECT user_registry,
           NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY ffv) as ffv_quartile,
           NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY sls DESC) as sls_quartile
    FROM fan_scores
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 2 AND sls_quartile = 2 THEN 'Ideal Fans'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 2 AND sls_quartile = 1 THEN 'At-Risk VIPs'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 1 AND sls_quartile = 2 THEN 'Quiet Majority'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 1 AND sls_quartile = 1 THEN 'Resource Drain'
    END as segment,
    COUNT(*) as fan_count
FROM fan_quadrants
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 2 AND sls_quartile = 2 THEN 'Ideal Fans'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 2 AND sls_quartile = 1 THEN 'At-Risk VIPs'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 1 AND sls_quartile = 2 THEN 'Quiet Majority'
        WHEN ffv_quartile = 1 AND sls_quartile = 1 THEN 'Resource Drain'
